abilities.effect: The tunnel collapses in a cave-in that deals 4d8+10 bludgeoning damage to the triggering creature and all creatures in area A2 (DC 21 basic Reflex save). On a failed save, the triggering creature is immobilized (Escape DC 21). This collapse fully blocks the tunnel (area A2), making it impassable.
abilities.name: Collapse
abilities.trigger: A creature moves into the unstable tunnel

hazard.description: The tunel collapses, filling the passage with stone
hazard.disable: DC 25 Survival (trained) to prop up the tunnel ceiling without triggering a collapse
hazard.name: Cave-In

traits.text: A hazard with this trait is something dangerous that’s part of the natural world, such as quicksand or harmful mold.
